correctness.rationale: The involution has eight fixed triples and 28 eligible pairs. Projecting a balanced cycle to the vertex classes of negative reversal gives even undirected degrees, counting loops twice. Six odd vertices in the full quotient force at least three omitted pairs. Exactly three omissions must form a perfect matching of those six vertices. The two matchings have nonzero residual divergence differences (-2 at 12 and +2 at 03, respectively). This difference is invariant under replacing a triple by its negative reversal, so neither matching can leave a balanced set. The 24 cyclic windows of the witness meet all exclusions and their distinctness also ensures least period 24. An independent bounded enumeration reproduced the degrees, both matchings, both residuals and all witness checks. Frozen replay path: verify.py, with verification_output.txt alongside the original RESULT.md; the uploaded script was not executed. The proof is only for alphabet four and window length three; no extremizer classification is obtained.
